bio.text: Jill Tokuda represents Hawai'i's Second Congressional District in the U.S. House and serves on the Armed Services and Agriculture committees.
From 2006 to 2018 she represented Kaneohe and Kailua in the Hawai'i State Senate, where she chaired the Ways and Means Committee, among others.
She earned a bachelor's degree in international relations at The George Washington University; her office says her family has lived in the district for four generations.
